name: vsnewt
description: Edit, compile, run, and debug NewtonScript (Apple Newton) with the newtc compiler and debugger.

commands.title: Save the newtc App for the Newton...
Stop the Debug Server (disconnects the Newton)
Compile NSOF with VSNewt for debugging

program.description: What to run: a NewtonScript file (.ns) is compiled and run; a package (.pkg) is loaded with its debug map and installed (its InstallScript runs). A package the project builds (vsnewt.main, else the file in the editor, with the same name) is built first, like F7.

newtc.description: Path of the newtc executable. Default: the setting vsnewt.newtcPath, else the newtc that comes with the extension.

log.description: Write all Debug Adapter Protocol messages to this file (newtc -dap-log).

debugMap.description: For a package: the debug map (.nsdbg, from `newtc -pkg <package> -odecompile <file.ns>`) that shows its functions in the decompiled source. Default: the .nsdbg next to the package with the same name, if there is one.

args.description: More newtc arguments, run in order before the program (e.g. ["-pkg", "lib.pkg", "-nsdbg", "lib.nsdbg"]). Not used with debugServer.

debugServer.description: For working on newtc: connect to a newtc started as `newtc -dap-server <port>` (e.g. in a debugger) instead of starting one.

target.description: Run and debug the program on a Newton instead of in newtc: "tcp" for Einstein (newtc listens on 127.0.0.1:3679, where Einstein's serial port connects; tap "Connect" in the newtc app on the Newton), "tcp:<port>", or "serial:<device>[@<bps>]" for a MessagePad (e.g. "serial:/dev/cu.usbserial-1420@38400"). The Newton needs the newtc app (command "NewtonScript: Save the newtc App for the Newton"; install it once) or NTK's Toolkit.pkg; newtc installs what else it needs. newtc then runs in the background and keeps the Newton connected between sessions.

reinstall.description: With target: upload the package to the Newton even if it is unchanged there since the last upload, so its InstallScript runs again (some apps reset their state in it). Default: an unchanged package is not uploaded again.

target.description: The Newton to attach to: "tcp" for Einstein (tap "Connect" in the newtc app on the Newton), "tcp:<port>", or "serial:<device>[@<bps>]". Nothing is installed or run: the Newton goes on as it is, and breakpoints, exceptions, and BreakLoop() stop it. Disconnecting removes the breakpoints and lets it run on.

program.description: The package (.pkg) that is already installed on the Newton, for its source lines: compiled with -g, or with a debug map (debugMap). Optional.

debugMap.description: For a decompiled package: its debug map (.nsdbg, from `newtc -pkg <package> -odecompile <file.ns>`).

newtc.description: Path of the newtc executable. Default: the setting vsnewt.newtcPath, else the newtc that comes with the extension.

log.description: Write all Debug Adapter Protocol messages to this file (newtc -dap-log).

configurationSnippets.label: NewtonScript: Run file
configurationSnippets.description: Run a NewtonScript file with newtc in the debugger.

configurationSnippets.label: NewtonScript: Debug a package
configurationSnippets.description: Debug a package in its decompiled source (command "NewtonScript: Decompile a Package for Debugging" writes <name>_dec.ns and <name>_dec.nsdbg). The package itself runs, unchanged.

configurationSnippets.label: NewtonScript: Connect to newtc -dap-server
configurationSnippets.description: For working on newtc: run `newtc -dap-server 4711` (e.g. in lldb), then start this configuration.

configurationSnippets.label: NewtonScript: Run on Einstein
configurationSnippets.description: Run a NewtonScript file or package on Einstein (tap "Connect" in the newtc app on the Newton).

configurationSnippets.label: NewtonScript: Run on a MessagePad
configurationSnippets.description: Run a NewtonScript file or package on a MessagePad on a serial port (tap "Connect" in the newtc app on the Newton).

configurationSnippets.label: NewtonScript: Attach to Einstein
configurationSnippets.description: Attach to Einstein without installing anything; program (optional) is the package installed there, for its source lines.

vsnewt.main.markdownDescription: The project's main source file (relative to the workspace folder), e.g. `MyApp.ns`: **F7** builds it into a package next to it (`MyApp.pkg`, with debug information), and **F5** without a `launch.json` runs that package. Empty: F7 builds the NewtonScript file in the active editor.

vsnewt.newtcPath.markdownDescription: Path of the `newtc` executable, e.g. a development build. Empty: use the `newtc` that comes with the extension (`bin/<platform>-<arch>/newtc`).

scripts.package: npm run compile && vsce package --target darwin-arm64
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
